articles.headline: Regulator fines Meta over data-protection violations
articles.summary: A regulator imposed a financial penalty on Meta over alleged violations involving user data protection practices.
articles.body: The regulator imposed a fine on Meta Platforms over data-protection violations involving Facebook and Instagram user information. The action directly names Meta and concerns its own platform operations.

articles.headline: TSMC advanced packaging interruption affects CoWoS capacity in Taiwan
articles.summary: A temporary interruption affected TSMC CoWoS advanced packaging capacity used for high-performance AI chips.
articles.body: TSMC reported a temporary disruption in CoWoS advanced packaging operations in Taiwan. The affected packaging capacity is used for high-performance AI accelerators. Wafer fabrication operations were reported as continuing normally.

articles.headline: Regional power outage temporarily disrupts a small electronics supplier in Malaysia
articles.summary: A small electronics supplier in Malaysia temporarily halted production after a regional power outage.
articles.body: A regional power outage temporarily stopped production at a small electronics-components supplier in Malaysia. The report does not identify any relationship with Apple, Nvidia, Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta or Tesla, and no customer or supplier link is established.

articles.headline: US expands export-license restrictions on advanced AI chips sold to China
articles.summary: New export-license restrictions cover advanced AI accelerators sold to China and directly affect Nvidia while potentially affecting other companies exposed to AI infrastructure demand.
articles.body: The U.S. government announced expanded export-license restrictions on advanced AI accelerators sold to China. Nvidia is directly named because the restrictions cover products in its advanced data-center accelerator portfolio. Other technology companies may have indirect exposure through cloud infrastructure, supply chains or AI investment, but no specific financial impact is established in this report.
